price_search_scope: One continuous linear program per maximal remaining short-sheet count vector. Apply every resulting integer certificate to all 428 survivors.
support: Every point of the original cog lies in a disk of radius 141 mm. Its occupied area is rounded down to a whole square millimetre. Every original angle and every overlapping combination of horizontal projections is permitted.
column_bound: Enumerate all bracket and insert vertical-section combinations. With k active cogs bound their summed height by min(282*k, 313 minus discrete height), then charge slope times that height minus the per-cog intercept times k. The largest bound for k >= 2 occurs at k = 2.
